newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close moderately lower in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close moderately lower in light trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately lower on Tuesday, as leading exporters remained weighed down by caution over the currency market, brokers said.
Many participants retreated to the sidelines, waiting for clearer direction from the market. Trade was subdued due to the absence of foreign investors and domestic dealers, they said.
The 225-share Nikkei average lost 153.61 points or 0.77 percent to finish at 19,889.89. Its June futures were down 290 points at 19,860.
